# lalr: written by build.sh from toys/lalr.y; do not edit.
level left T
level left HIGH
rule 0 s: X g T Z
rule 1 s: Y g
rule 2 g: e
rule 3 g: W T Q
rule 4 e: W %prec HIGH
refuse	-	X
refuse	-	Y
refuse	-	X W
accept	4:1-2,2:1-2,1:0-2	Y W
refuse	-	X W T
refuse	-	Y W T
refuse	-	X W T Q
accept	4:1-2,2:1-2,0:0-4	X W T Z
refuse	-	Y W T Q
refuse	-	X W T Q T
refuse	-	X W T Q T Z
